card1.description: Every customer gets a referral code tied to their account, with zero manual setup. The code appears right on the order confirmation page, the moment they're most excited to recommend you, lifting sharing rates by over 30%.
card1.title: Your customers become marketers automatically

card2.description: Cashback as a percentage of the order, a fixed amount, or custom loyalty points, for both the referrer and their friend. And crucially: you choose when the reward is released, with a holding period that protects you against returns.
card2.title: You decide the reward and when it pays out

card3.description: Referral fraud is the most overlooked risk, it quietly destroys conversion rates and inflates your rewards bill. Set a minimum order value, limit rewards to a new customer's first order only, and cap referrals per customer or overall.
card3.title: Rules that protect you from abuse

card4.description: A dashboard showing your latest referrals, top referrers, and performance metrics, with referral details surfaced inside each customer profile and order page. And your customers get notified the moment their reward lands.
card4.title: Fully tracked and connected to your store data
